#+TITLE: Leaking Blocks Demo

A fixed-width area is verbatim:

: fixed line one
: fixed line two

An HTML export block passes through untouched:

#+BEGIN_EXPORT html
<div class="raw-widget">passthrough</div>
#+END_EXPORT

A LaTeX export block contributes nothing to HTML:

#+BEGIN_EXPORT latex
\emph{dropped}
#+END_EXPORT

A dynamic block re-parses its body as real blocks:

#+BEGIN: generated :cols 2
- item alpha
- item beta
#+END:
